title: spec: the security-service contract never names the `ownerMayEdit` opt-in, so its `allow` bullet and "requires EDIT access to its master" are incomplete for an opted-in controlled_by_parent detail
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eHDXrsKgGAUHq956U

Filing gate: ① defect in published contract text (a should-fix from the seat's contract review of PR #31126, card #31094, ③), found by the card's Fable review and confirmed by the seat's. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: `domain:spec` — `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts` (`ControlledByParentWriteOutcome` `allow` bullet; `ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite` docblock), next PR that touches it.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "ownerMayEdit security-service jsdoc" → 4 hits (#31094 the source card, #30906 / #30907 the optional-master series, the triage seat post); none covers the opt-in.
reach: contract text read by every consumer of `ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite` (the attachments and comments gates the docblock names). Read from the code on `main`, not run.
class: b · type: Bug

## What is wrong

`assertControlledByParentWrite` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`, the by-id update owner branch) admits a by-id `update` by the row's owner holding only READ on the master when the relation carries `ownerMayEdit`, the write is not on behalf of another user, the stored `owner_id` is the caller, and the body does not empty an optional master. The served member meets those conditions and returns `allow` without any leg passing on the master. ADR-0055 records the opt-in (§3 amendment, ruling 6398566164 on #25760).

`security-service.ts` names `ownerMayEdit` nowhere, on `main` and after PR #31126. So the `allow` bullet ("every leg passes on every master …") and the member's "requires EDIT access to its master" read as exhaustive and are false for an opted-in detail.

## Owed

Measure the opt-in leg's conditions in the gate, then add one clause to the `allow` bullet and the member docblock naming `ownerMayEdit` and its conditions, citing ADR-0055 §3 as amended. JSDoc only; `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (triage to confirm).

Related: #31094, PR #31126, #25760, ADR-0055.
